mapper.select:
select stk.stkId, stk.stkQuantity, cf.cfName, cf.cfCategory, cf.cfGrade, cf.cfType, lp.zoneName, lp.rackName, lp.cellName, wh.whName from stock stk join coffee cf on stk.cfId = cf.cfId join location_places lp on stk.lpId = lp.lpId join locations l on l.lpId = lp.lpId join warehouse wh on wh.whId = l.whId
limit #{criteria.skip}, #{criteria.amount}

select wh.whCode, wh.whName, wh.whGrade, wh.whAddress, sum(stk.stkQuantity) as stkQuantity from warehouse wh join locations l on wh.whId = l.whId join location_places lp on l.lpId = lp.lpId join stock stk on stk.lpId = lp.lpId group by wh.whCode, wh.whName, wh.whGrade, wh.whAddress
select comId, comName, comCode, comEmail, comPhone, comStartDate, comExpiredDate from companies

select dd.ddId, wh.whCode, stk.stkId, dd.ddStatus, dd.ddApproval, dd.ddDate, dd.ddUpdateDate from stock stk join due_diligence dd on dd.stkId = stk.stkId join location_places lp on lp.lpId = stk.lpId join locations l on l.lpId = lp.lpId join warehouse wh on wh.whId = l.whId where dd.isDelete = 0 order by dd.ddId desc limit #{skip}, #{amount}

select stk.stkId, wh.whCode, lp.zoneName, lp.rackName, lp.cellName, stk.stkQuantity, dd.realStkQuantity, dd.ddDate, dd.maId, dd.ddLog from stock stk join due_diligence dd on dd.stkId = stk.stkId join location_places lp on lp.lpId = stk.lpId join locations l on l.lpId = lp.lpId join warehouse wh on wh.whId = l.whId where dd.ddId = #{ddId} and dd.isDelete = 0
